stem.text: The following statements are about the reaction of $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ with the three chloroalkanes shown.

items: $(\text{CH}_3)_2\text{CHCH}_2\text{Cl}$ reacts with NaOH(aq) by an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism.
The tertiary chloroalkane reacts more quickly than the others because the carbon atom bonded to the Cl atom is more positive in this molecule.
The Cl atoms in the three chloroalkanes are attacked by $\text{OH}^{-}$.
